question: Which of the following countries does not share border with India? (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 1)
options: Afghanistan
Bhutan
Nepal
Maldives
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Maldives

Explanation:
India shares its land border with seven countries: Pakistan, Afghanistan, China, Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, and Myanmar. Maldives is an island nation located in the Indian Ocean and does not share any land border with India. While India and Maldives share a maritime boundary, there is no terrestrial border. Therefore, among the given options, Maldives is the country that does not share a border with India. The other options—Afghanistan, Bhutan, and Nepal—all share land borders with India.

question: What are the drained areas formed by rivers called? (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 1)
options: Wells
Besin
Lake
Lagoon
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Besin

Explanation:
The drained area formed by rivers is called a basin or drainage basin. It is a geographical feature where all the water from rivers, streams, and rainfall drains into a common outlet, such as a larger river or ocean. Basins are defined by the topography and the flow of water. They are crucial for understanding hydrology and water management. The largest river basin in the world is the Amazon Basin, while in India, the Ganga Basin is the largest. Basins are also known as catchments or watersheds. They play a vital role in agriculture, ecology, and human settlement.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Another name for drainage area → Basin
☛ Largest river basin in the world → Amazon Basin
☛ Largest river basin in India → Ganga Basin
☛ Study of basins falls under → Hydrology
☛ Drainage basin is also called → Catchment area
question_hi: नदियों द्वारा निर्मित द्रोणियां (drained area) क्या कहलाता है?  (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 1)

question: A deep valley surrounded by steep and rocky walls is called _______. (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 3)
options: Shell
rock bend
Glacier
narrow river valley
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is narrow river valley

Explanation:
A deep valley with steep and rocky walls is called a narrow river valley or gorge. It is formed by river erosion cutting through hard rocks, resulting in nearly vertical slopes. These are commonly found in plateaus or mountainous regions, like the Grand Canyon. Glacial valleys are U-shaped, while narrow river valleys are V-shaped. The other options, shell and rock bend, are incorrect.

☛ What shape is a glacial valley? → U-shaped
☛ Which is the deepest gorge in the world? → Kali Gandaki Gorge, Nepal
☛ Example of a narrow river valley → Grand Canyon
☛ A valley with steep rocky walls is called? → Narrow river valley

question: In which state is the Koodankulam Nuclear Power Plant located? (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 3)

solution:

question: What is the distance between the Sun and planet Venus? (RPF SI 2018 (19/12/2018) Shift 3)
options: 108.2 million km
129.2 million km
69.2 million km
58.2 million km
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 108.2 million km

Explanation:
The average distance between the Sun and the planet Venus is approximately 108.2 million km. Venus is the second closest planet to the Sun, after Mercury. Its orbit is nearly circular, so the distance varies little. Venus is often called Earth's twin because of its similar size and mass. It appears in the sky as the morning or evening star, known as the brightest planet visible from Earth. Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun. Its average distance from the Sun is about 57.91 million kilometers (36 million miles). This distance is approximately 0.387 times the Earth-Sun distance. question: In which of the following regions is the Karakoram Range located? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Eastern India
North-eastern India
Southern India
Northern India
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Northern India

Explanation:
The Karakoram Range is located in Northern India, specifically in the union territory of Ladakh. It is the second-highest mountain range in the world and includes K2 (Mount Godwin-Austen), the second-highest peak on Earth. The Karakoram is not part of the Himalayan range but is a separate mountain system. This range extends across the borders of India, Pakistan, and China. It contains some of the largest glaciers outside the polar regions, such as the Siachen Glacier. Northern India's region also includes the Zanskar and Ladakh ranges. The name 'Karakoram' means 'black gravel' in Turkish, referring to the dark-colored rocks found there.

question: Which of the following mountain passes connects India with China? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Thal Ghat
Nathula
Rohtang Pass
Zoji La
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nathula

Explanation:
Nathula Pass connects the Indian state of Sikkim with China's Tibet Autonomous Region. Located at an altitude of approximately 4,310 meters above sea level, it was a key part of the ancient Silk Route. After the 1962 India-China war, it was closed but was reopened in 2006 for border trade. It is one of the three functional trading routes between India and China. Thal Ghat is situated in Maharashtra, Rohtang Pass in Himachal Pradesh, and Zoji La Pass in Ladakh, none of which connect to China.

question: Slash and Burn agriculture is known as ___________ in Madhya Pradesh. (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Koman
Pama Dabi
Bringa
Dahiya
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Dahiya

Explanation:
In Madhya Pradesh, Slash and Burn agriculture (shifting cultivation) is known as Dahiya. This traditional method involves cutting and burning forests to clear land for cultivation. After a few years, when soil fertility declines, farmers move to another area. This practice has different names across India. For instance, in Andhra Pradesh it is called Podu, in Northeast India it is called Jhum, in Chhattisgarh it is Deepa, in Bihar it is known as Dahiya or Bewar, in Rajasthan it is Walter or Kuruva, and in Kerala it is Ponam.

question: On 3 February 1925, the first electric train in India ran between which two stations? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 1)

Predominantly agrarian
Fully developed

question: Which of the following locations holds the significance of being the headquarters of the South Central Zone of the Indian Railways? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 2)

solution:

Explanation:
The headquarters of the South Central Zone of Indian Railways is located at Secunderabad (Telangana). Established in 1966, this zone is divided into 6 divisions: Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Guntur, Guntakal, Nanded, and Vijayawada. South Central Railway connects southern and central parts of India, covering areas in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, and Karnataka. बिलासपुर
सिकंदराबाद

Explanation:
भारतीय रेलवे के दक्षिण मध्य क्षेत्र का मुख्यालय सिकंदराबाद (तेलंगाना) में स्थित है। इस क्षेत्र की स्थापना 1966 में हुई थी और यह 6 रेलवे मंडलों में विभाजित है: सिकंदराबाद, हैदराबाद, गुंटूर, गुंटकल, नांदेड़ और विजयवाड़ा। दक्षिण मध्य रेलवे भारत के दक्षिणी और मध्य भागों को जोड़ता है, जिसमें आंध्र प्रदेश, तेलंगाना, महाराष्ट्र और कर्नाटक के क्षेत्र शामिल हैं। हुबली दक्षिण पश्चिम रेलवे, चेन्नई दक्षिण रेलवे और बिलासपुर दक्षिण पूर्व मध्य रेलवे के मुख्यालय हैं। इसलिए सिकंदराबाद सही विकल्प है।

question: Which major river divides the Peninsular Plateau into two parts? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Ganga
Godavari
Narmada
Krishna
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Narmada

Explanation:
The Peninsular Plateau is a major geographical region of India, divided into two parts by the Narmada River. North of the Narmada lies the Central Indian Plateau (Bundelkhand, Malwa, Baghelkhand), while to the south is the Deccan Plateau. The Narmada flows from east to west and empties into the Arabian Sea. It is often called the lifeline of Madhya Pradesh and is the fifth largest river in India. The river originates from the Amarkantak hill in Madhya Pradesh. The Narmada valley is home to several waterfalls and dams.

question_hi: कौन सी प्रमुख नदी प्रायद्वीपीय पठार को दो भागों में विभाजित करती है? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 2)

गोदावरी
नर्मदा
कृष्णा
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है नर्मदा

Explanation:
प्रायद्वीपीय पठार भारत का एक प्रमुख भौगोलिक क्षेत्र है, जिसे नर्मदा नदी दो भागों में विभाजित करती है। नर्मदा नदी के उत्तर में मध्य भारत का पठार (बुंदेलखंड, मालवा, बघेलखंड) और दक्षिण में दक्कन का पठार स्थित है। यह नदी पूर्व से पश्चिम की ओर बहती है और अरब सागर में गिरती है। नर्मदा नदी को मध्य प्रदेश की जीवन रेखा भी कहा जाता है। यह भारत की पांचवीं सबसे बड़ी नदी है और इसका उद्गम अमरकंटक पहाड़ी से होता है। नर्मदा नदी घाटी में कई जलप्रपात और बांध स्थित हैं।

question: Which of the following is mainly labour-intensive farming and utilises high doses of biochemical inputs and irrigation to obtain higher production? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Dryland farming
Intensive subsistence farming
Commercial plantation
Primitive subsistence farming
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Intensive subsistence farming

Explanation:
Intensive subsistence farming involves cultivating small land holdings with high labor inputs, biochemical inputs (fertilizers, pesticides), and irrigation to maximize production. It is mainly practiced in densely populated regions of Asia where land is scarce. Dryland farming depends on rainfall and has low inputs. Commercial plantation involves large-scale monoculture and is capital intensive. Primitive subsistence farming uses primitive tools and no chemical inputs.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Where is intensive subsistence farming prevalent? → Densely populated regions of Asia
☛ What are the main inputs in intensive subsistence farming? → Labor and biochemical inputs
☛ What does dryland farming depend on? → Rainfall
☛ What type of farming is commercial plantation? → Large-scale monoculture
☛ What tools are used in primitive subsistence farming? → Primitive tools
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी कृषि मुख्य रूप से श्रम-गहन है और उच्च उत्पादन प्राप्त करने के लिए जैव रासायनिक निवेश और सिंचाई की उच्च खुराक का उपयोग करती है? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 2)

गहन निर्वाह कृषि
वाणिज्यिक बागान
आदिम निर्वाह कृषि
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है गहन निर्वाह कृषि

Explanation:
गहन निर्वाह कृषि में भूमि के छोटे टुकड़ों पर अधिक श्रम और जैव रासायनिक निवेश (उर्वरक, कीटनाशक) तथा सिंचाई का उपयोग करके अधिकतम उत्पादन प्राप्त किया जाता है। यह मुख्यतः एशिया के घनी आबादी वाले क्षेत्रों में प्रचलित है जहाँ भूमि सीमित है। शुष्क भूमि कृषि वर्षा पर निर्भर होती है और इसमें निवेश कम होता है। वाणिज्यिक बागान में बड़े पैमाने पर एक फसल उगाई जाती है और यह पूंजी गहन होता है। आदिम निर्वाह कृषि में आदिम औजारों से खेती की जाती है और इसमें रासायनिक निवेश नहीं होता।

question: The southern branch of which of the following jet streams (high winds) plays an important role in the winter season in north and northwestern India?  (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: Polar-Night Jet Stream
Tropical Easterly Jet Stream
African Easterly Jet
Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream

Explanation:
The southern branch of the Subtropical Westerly Jet Stream plays a crucial role in the winter season over north and northwestern India. This jet stream flows at about 12-14 km altitude near 30°N latitude and brings western disturbances, which cause winter rainfall and snowfall. The Polar-Night Jet Stream is found over polar regions in winter. The Tropical Easterly Jet Stream is active over India during summer and influences the southwest monsoon. The African Easterly Jet is located over Africa.

☛ In which season is the Tropical Easterly Jet active? → Summer (monsoon)
☛ Where is the Polar-Night Jet Stream found? → Over polar regions in winter
☛ Over which continent is the African Easterly Jet found? → Africa
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से किस जेट स्ट्रीम (तेज़ हवाएँ) की दक्षिणी शाखा उत्तर और उत्तर-पश्चिमी भारत में शीतकालीन मौसम में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है? (RPF Constable 2024 (02/03/2025) Shift 2)

उपोष्णकटिबंधीय पश्चिमी जेट स्ट्रीम की दक्षिणी शाखा शीतकाल में उत्तर और उत्तर-पश्चिमी भारत में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है। यह जेट स्ट्रीम 30°N अक्षांश के पास लगभग 12-14 किमी की ऊंचाई पर बहती है और पश्चिमी विक्षोभों को लाती है जो शीतकालीन वर्षा और बर्फबारी के लिए जिम्मेदार होते हैं। ध्रुवीय-रात्रि जेट धारा ध्रुवीय क्षेत्रों में सर्दियों में पाई जाती है। उष्णकटिबंधीय पूर्वी जेट धारा गर्मियों में भारत के ऊपर सक्रिय होती है और दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून को प्रभावित करती है। अफ्रीकी पूर्वी जेट अफ्रीका के ऊपर पाई जाती है।
